reuse.why: All providers share prepareBankAccountLink, bank lookup reuses findOrCreateBank, and unlinking shares clearBankLink, although Fintegra copies the surrounding provider workflows.

duplication.why: Fintegra adds another copy of the account-link lifecycle and the authenticated transaction-download workflow already present for other providers.

placement.why: Link orchestration, transaction downloading, endpoint configuration, and provider models remain in their established modules and layers.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested linking policies, Fintegra support, associated tests, and necessary provider registrations.

maintainability.why: Centralized linking policies and local unlink cleanup are straightforward to maintain, but copying two substantial provider workflows increases future maintenance work.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link handlers call prepareBankAccountLink and findOrCreateBank, while replacement and ordinary unlinking both use clearBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated Fintegra linking and downloading workflows are direct provider-specific copies rather than reshaped logic concealing duplication.

abstraction_drift.where: prepareBankAccountLink gains the requested replaceExistingLink policy flag; its rules remain provider-independent, and every link handler uses it.
